An 'external' GDScript or C# implementation of this feature, as long as it uses and wraps the curent `NoiseTexture2D` would be suboptimal as its performance would be sub optimal as reasoned above.

A C++ GDExtension implementation would most likely end up duplicating the `NoiseTexture2D` code only to add a relatively minor but fundamental change in the way the noise is sampled.
answers.workaround: I can't think of a reasonable workaround, as per the "Describe the problem" section above. Lack of this feature forces a suboptimal path with architectural and performance implications.
